name: red-new-session-off-by-one
note: G1 design §9, item 2, and the reason §2 frames the predicate as boundary-AFTER-bar. Two IST sessions of three bars. The first session's object must end on bar 2, its own session's LAST bar. Rewriting the predicate as the intuitive day-change-at-bar form `day(t) != day(s)` fires on bar 3 instead -- the NEXT session's OPENING bar -- because §3's geometry is inclusive. That is bug 3 from the first conversion, reintroduced by construction, and it is a one-bar difference this fixture is built to catch: expected x2bar 2, mutant x2bar 3.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
newday = na(dayofmonth[1]) or dayofmonth != dayofmonth[1]
plotlevel(newday, close, "SR", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.new_session)
